top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric first aid.

top_violation_types.title: Employee Handwashing After Handling or Cleaning Bodily Fluids (26 TAC §746.3415(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the monitoring inspection a caregiver wiped two children's noses and did not wash their hands. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver was asked to wash their hands, and did, and the expectations for hand washing after wiping noses was explained.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Employee Handwashing After Removing Gloves (26 TAC §746.3415(13))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver was observed not washing their hands after removing their gloves.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not provided parents with a copy of the parent's rights form 2987 as required.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not been documenting their monthly maintenance inspections.

top_violation_types.title: Required Postings-Licensing notices with instructions to post (26 TAC §746.401(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The permit renewal notice was not posted.    This was corrected at inspection when the permit renewal notice was printed and posted.
